spec: §15 suite E (aggregation from event lists; timing model); §8.2: count sums per-event costs each leaf exactly once; time is the makespan; peak is the maximum concurrently live wires per class; a class absent from rate has rate 1 (§17 item 11)
derivation: events.json specifies two CX leaves, sequential at [0,1) and [1,2), on disjoint pairs whose live intervals equal those event intervals, then a classical step at [2,3). Gate count is 1+1+0=2 (leaves exactly once), makespan 3, peak fast wires 2, occupancy 2*1+2*1=4 at default rate 1. Disjoint operands alone do not determine live intervals.
